scripts.dev: npm run build -w @qbr/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,worker,client "npm run dev -w @qbr/server" "npm run dev:worker -w @qbr/server" "npm run dev -w @qbr/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @qbr/contracts && npm run build -w @qbr/server && npm run build -w @qbr/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @qbr/contracts && npm run test -w @qbr/server
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @qbr/contracts && npm run test:integration -w @qbr/server
scripts.evaluate: npm run build -w @qbr/contracts && npm run evaluate -w @qbr/server --
